description: GPU calibration corpus: the CPU calibration cases, each also observed through Skia Graphite on Dawn (gpu-raster, gpu-receipt, provider-census). Run with --lane-module tools/parity/lanes/gpu.py and implementations/pulp-design-ir-observer-gpu.json. Calibration seed corpus. Sources are paths inside a Pulp checkout at the calibrated commit (--source-root), except source_base=corpus cases, which resolve beside this file. The bottom-right 2px corner of every case is bare root background; the pointer-moved control relies on it.

params.allow_extra_webgpu_api_justification: Pulp's pulp-render links the wgpu-native webgpu target PUBLIC on macOS alongside Skia's static Dawn, so every Pulp GPU image also loads wgpu-native, a second (non-Dawn) WebGPU C API. Recorded, not endorsed: D4 has to rule on it. Any other extra exporter still fails.

cases.note: The scene's asset_ref images are reference art for audio widgets, not paint inputs: calibration showed a byte-identical render with and without them, so they are not staged. image-asset-design-ir is the case that consumes an asset.

params.gpu_pixels_match_cpu_justification: Measured: this case is a solid fill and an unscaled image blit, and Graphite and the CPU raster produce byte-identical pixels for it, so a silent CPU fallback cannot be seen in gpu-raster here. provider-census and gpu-receipt still reject that fallback on this case.
